top_choice_rationale: Halide perovskites give a clear structure-to-function story: ABX3 composition, cation and halide mixing and defect chemistry set absorption, carrier lifetime and band gap, and solution-processed absorbers reaching well above 25 percent efficiency have been reproduced independently worldwide for over a decade. The citation can rest on the absorber and its demonstrated efficiency, which keeps open stability and lead questions outside what is credited. Miyasaka (first perovskite-sensitized cell), Park and Snaith (solid-state thin-film devices) follow the chain of discovery, though the cut among six claimants is contestable. Targeted protein degradation (P001) is a close second on science but credit is split across lineages and no heterobifunctional degrader is approved; P003 adds base editing, whose chemistry is classical deamination and which follows the 2020 prize closely; P004 rests on in vivo relevance that is still debated; no award is last because several candidates are mature.
